text: APPROVE. I traced every branch of the old loop against the new helpers (comment ends, the `$`/`@` prefix scan, raw strings, verbatim and escaped strings, unterminated cases, and the `Math.Min` clamp) and found no behaviour change. By my hand count, `Lex` is now trivially low and the worst helper, `StringEnd`, comes to about 15, so it is at the threshold. I could not build the project or see the rest of the file, so a name clash with an existing member or a type mismatch on `List<Literal>`/`char[]` is the one remaining risk.
